name: Loading
description: Signals that something is happening when you cannot say how long it will take.

variant.description: Visual style of the loading animation

centered.description: Whether to center the loading indicator in its container

fill.description: Whether to fill the parent container

overlay.description: Whether to show with a backdrop overlay

color.description: Color variant - accent uses theme color, current inherits text color

when: Waiting on an async action to come back
Buttons, forms, and page sections mid-request
The first paint of an app or page
whenNot: You know the percentage — use Progress
You know the page shape — use Skeleton
guidelines: Always pass a label describing what is loading
Loading.Screen for first page load, Loading.Inline to sit inside a sentence
accessibility: label is what a screen reader reads — make it specific

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Spinner at medium size, accent coloured.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: sm inside controls, xl for a whole page.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="lg" align="center">
  <Loading size="sm" label="Loading" />
  <Loading size="md" label="Loading" />
  <Loading size="lg" label="Loading" />
  <Loading size="xl" label="Loading" />
</Stack>
